note: Sidecar to DESIGN.md: extended per-component properties (shadow, motion, disabled state) that don't fit DESIGN.md's 8-prop component schema (backgroundColor, textColor, typography, rounded, padding, size, height, width).

shared.transition: transform 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.12s ease, opacity 0.2s ease

critter.technique: four stacked raster frames (exports/critter-{mood}.png), mood driven entirely by a [data-mood] attribute on a wrapper element; frames crossfade via opacity transition, no per-mood JS branching

idle-bob.description: continuous gentle up-down bob on the critter wrapper, all moods, always running

blink.description: periodic brief scale-squash on the active frame, all four moods, independent of the idle bob

dur-mood-shift.description: crossfade duration when the active mood frame changes

critter-glow.description: subtle pulse/breathe on the glowing-mood halo, layered on top of the baked-in glow art

mouth-breathe.description: sleepy-only: a small circle in {colors.label-outline}, top-anchored at (left 47.8%, top 42%) of the critter box just below the nose tip, scales from a fixed top edge (transform-origin 50% 0%) so it only grows downward toward the chin, never upward into the nose — the nose-to-mouth gap in the art is only ~2% of the box height, too tight for a center-anchored scale
